stated.quote: I came to Congress to protect and defend our national security, and I recognize that safeguarding our national security requires a strong national defense. stated.quote: I believe that we must reduce wasteful spending, eliminate fraud, and streamline government operations so that innovation can thrive. stated.reasoning: Text explicitly advocates reducing wasteful spending and right-sizing government spending.
